lead.title: Yazen raises €50M led by Verdane to scale its digital obesity care across Europe
lead.deck: The Lund-based Swedish company, active in eight countries, reports over 70,000 patients since launch with more than 50,000 currently in treatment; previous lead Evli Growth Partners participates. Announced Oct. 8 and covered Oct. 13: the signal is obesity turning into a care vertical of its own.

milestone.title: NHS England announces an £838M open framework for the future of GP IT
milestone.summary: Three lots: foundation record capabilities (appointments, prescribing, referrals), clinical and operational support (decision support, video consultation, remote monitoring) and research and development. Procurement expected to open in November 2026, framework launch anticipated in Q3 2027.
milestone.why: Multiple suppliers per lot and periodic reopenings: an entry point for patient-record and clinical-AI scale-ups into a major captive market.

brefsEurope.title: RDaSH rolls out Accurx Scribe across mental health services, starting with older people
brefsEurope.summary: Trust-wide rollout: the ambient voice tool drafts clinical notes and referral letters, which clinicians approve before they enter the patient record.

word.definition: Software that analyzes patient data and gives clinicians alerts, reminders or suggestions to support — not replace — their decision.

parts.label: Clinician interface
parts.role: the alert at the right time

how.t: The software reads the record: vitals, labs, free text.
A model flags at-risk patients or missed diagnoses.
The clinician gets a suggestion and keeps the final call.

word.why: When decision support influences a clinical act it falls under the EU medical device regulation (Class IIa in practice): certification becomes both a moat and an entry barrier.

startups.name: Tandem Health
startups.use: AI scribe, coding assistant and clinical decision support certified MDR Class IIa; $100M Series B led by EQT's Scaleup Europe Fund.

startups.name: Healthleap
startups.use: Screens inpatient records each night for hidden diagnoses; $38M (seed and Series A), used in over 50 hospitals.

startups.name: Brainomix
startups.use: e-Lung, chest-imaging AI whose progression and treatment-response measures were used in a Phase III trial.
